command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk proxy cat /Users/nk/.codex/RTK.md .agents/skills/content-search-audit/SKILL.md
rtk proxy ls -la
rtk proxy rg --files --hidden targets .agents/skills/content-search-audit'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy rg -n 'start|campaign-report|review |inventory' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/helper-commands.md
rtk proxy cat .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/quote-verification.md
rtk proxy awk 'FNR==1{print FILENAME} {print FNR \":\" "'$0}'"' targets/*.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sed -n '1,128p' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/helper-commands.md
rtk proxy cat .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/examples/worked-review.mjs
rtk proxy rg -n 'studySources|campaign-start|campaign-review' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/{measurement,campaigns}.md
rtk proxy cat .agents/skills/content-search-audit/references/judgment-and-advice.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sed -i '' \"s/\\\"url\\\":/\\\"uri\\\":/g\" audit-artifacts/config.json
rtk proxy node \""'$PWD/.agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/audit.mjs" start "$PWD/audit-artifacts/config.json" "$PWD/audit-artifacts/initial"
rtk proxy rg -n '"'ruleId|kind|type' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/rules/core.json
rtk proxy ls audit-artifacts/initial"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sed -n '80,115p;155,190p;215,250p;275,295p;365,385p' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/rules/core.json
rtk proxy head -3 audit-artifacts/initial/evidence.jsonl
rtk proxy cat audit-artifacts/initial/inventory.jsonl
rtk proxy rg -n 'http-response|schema-extraction|evidence kind|deterministic' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/{checks,review}.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk proxy sed -n '1,144p' .agents/skills/content-search-audit/scripts/lib/checks.mjs
rtk proxy cat .agents/skills/content-search-audit/schemas/evidence.schema.json
rtk proxy cat audit-artifacts/initial/delivery-summary.md"
